requirements.HEIGHT: Complete independently verified board-number range, not provider reported counts alone
requirements.THEME: Narrow contemporaneous trade theme, adequate members, complete competitors, ladder diffusion and feedback; business association alone is insufficient
requirements.TURNOVER: Actual intraday open/absorption/reseal path and relative stress strength
requirements.CAPACITY: Same-theme non-limit members, comparable amounts and capacity evidence
requirements.TREND: Same-theme non-limit members and continuous unadjusted history
requirements.POSITION: Complete predeclared competitors, active win evidence, actual opponent failure
requirements.SUPPLEMENT: Prior core identity, same trade theme, launch order and dependency
requirements.NODE: Contemporaneous market transition, comparable trade theme, competition win and cross-day persistence
requirements.CYCLE: Continuous market stage, core role and cross-day persistence
requirements.CROSS_CYCLE: Ex ante pressure event, prior core identity and subsequent retention/reacquisition
requirements.EMOTION: Repeated stock/ecology feedback with common-catalyst review and temporal linkage
